title: Aqua Lodge - 2 Bedroom (6 People)
description: Got a bigger crew? No problem. Our two-bedroom Aqualodge with sleeper sofa fits up to six, so no one has to sit this trip out. Two bedrooms plus a pullout sofa means everyone gets a good night's sleep — and everyone wakes up to the same stunning view of Priest Lake right from the porch. Fire up the full kitchen for a group breakfast, claim your spot on the deck, and settle in for the kind of laid-back lake trip that's hard to top. The more, the merrier — and the more lake, the better.
